---
title: "Simulador de devaluación"
subtitle: "Exploración interactiva de escenarios para la industria manufacturera"
toc: true
---

Esta sección permite variar la magnitud del cierre de la brecha entre tipo de
cambio comercial y tipo de cambio de paridad, junto con la intensidad aplicada
a cada coeficiente de incidencia. El valor `100%` reproduce el escenario de
paridad calculado en el XLSX fuente; `0%` reproduce el escenario inicial.

::: {.callout-note}
Los módulos son estáticos y funcionan en el navegador a partir del JSON
preparado por `command-files/analysis-command-files/15_preparar_sitio_entregable_quarto.R`.
:::

El gráfico debe leerse como una comparación contra el escenario inicial de
cada año. El panel izquierdo muestra cuánto cambia la masa de ganancia en
términos absolutos; el panel derecho expresa ese mismo cambio como porcentaje
de la ganancia inicial. Una línea por encima de cero indica que la simulación
eleva la ganancia respecto del escenario inicial; una línea por debajo de cero
indica que la reduce. Los colores distinguen industria total, segmento
exportador y mercado interno.

## Escenario 1 - Comercio exterior

Incidencia directa de importaciones y exportaciones sobre producción, costos,
capital e intereses.

<div class="scenario-simulator" data-scenario="Escenario 1 - Comercio Exterior">
<div class="sim-module">
<div class="sim-content"></div>
</div>
</div>

## Escenario 2 - Bienes transables

Incidencia ampliada sobre bienes transables, incluidos aquellos producidos
localmente y vendidos en mercado interno.

<div class="scenario-simulator" data-scenario="Escenario 2 - Bienes Transables">
<div class="sim-module">
<div class="sim-content"></div>
</div>
</div>

<script>
const DATA_URL = "data/devaluacion_segmentos_20260830.json";
const COLORS = {
  navy: "#0B1F3A",
  deep: "#173B63",
  main: "#2F5F8F",
  steel: "#5F86AD",
  soft: "#9DB8D2",
  pale: "#DCE8F3",
  grey: "#6C7785",
  grid: "#D9E1E8"
};

const SECTIONS = [
  { value: "industria-total", label: "Industria total", color: COLORS.navy },
  { value: "exportadora", label: "Segmento exportador", color: COLORS.main },
  { value: "mercado-interno", label: "Mercado interno", color: COLORS.steel }
];

const VARIABLES = [
  {
    key: "vbp_pp",
    incidence: "incidencia_vbp_pp",
    delta: "delta_vbp_pp",
    label: "VBP",
    sign: 1,
    affectsCapital: false
  },
  {
    key: "consumo_intermedio_estimado",
    incidence: "incidencia_consumo_intermedio_estimado",
    delta: "delta_consumo_intermedio_estimado",
    label: "Consumo intermedio",
    sign: -1,
    affectsCapital: true
  },
  {
    key: "remuneraciones",
    incidence: "incidencia_remuneraciones",
    delta: "delta_remuneraciones",
    label: "Remuneraciones",
    sign: -1,
    affectsCapital: true
  },
  {
    key: "consumo_capital_fijo",
    incidence: "incidencia_consumo_capital_fijo",
    delta: "delta_consumo_capital_fijo",
    label: "Consumo capital fijo",
    sign: -1,
    affectsCapital: false
  },
  {
    key: "stock_capital_imputado",
    incidence: "incidencia_stock_capital_imputado",
    delta: "delta_stock_capital_imputado",
    label: "Stock imputado",
    sign: 0,
    affectsCapital: true
  },
  {
    key: "intereses_industria_pesos",
    incidence: "incidencia_intereses_industria_pesos",
    delta: "delta_intereses_industria_pesos",
    label: "Intereses",
    sign: 0,
    affectsCapital: false
  }
];

function numberValue(value) {
  const parsed = Number(value);
  return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : 0;
}

function percent(value, digits = 1) {
  if (!Number.isFinite(value)) return "s/d";
  return `${value.toLocaleString("es-UY", { maximumFractionDigits: digits, minimumFractionDigits: digits })}%`;
}

function moneyBillions(value) {
  if (!Number.isFinite(value)) return "s/d";
  const scaled = value / 1e9;
  return `${scaled.toLocaleString("es-UY", { maximumFractionDigits: 1, minimumFractionDigits: 1 })}`;
}

function pp(value) {
  if (!Number.isFinite(value)) return "s/d";
  return `${value.toLocaleString("es-UY", { maximumFractionDigits: 2, minimumFractionDigits: 2 })} pp`;
}

function computeScenario(row, state) {
  const factorBase = numberValue(row.tipo_cambio_paridad_pesos_usd) / numberValue(row.tipo_cambio_comercial_pesos_usd) - 1;
  const factorEffective = factorBase * state.devaluation / 100;
  const deltas = {};

  VARIABLES.forEach(variable => {
    const base = numberValue(row[variable.key]);
    const incidence = numberValue(row[variable.incidence]);
    const intensity = state.intensities[variable.key] / 100;
    deltas[variable.delta] = base * incidence * intensity * factorEffective;
  });

  const gainBase = numberValue(row.ganancia_pb);
  const capitalBase = numberValue(row.capital_total_adelantado);
  const rotation = numberValue(row.rotacion_calibrada_sobre_6_6);
  const interestsBase = numberValue(row.intereses_industria_pesos);
  const gainPostBase = numberValue(row.ganancia_pb_desp_intereses);

  const gainSim =
    gainBase +
    deltas.delta_vbp_pp -
    deltas.delta_consumo_intermedio_estimado -
    deltas.delta_remuneraciones -
    deltas.delta_consumo_capital_fijo;

  const capitalCirculatingDelta = rotation > 0
    ? (deltas.delta_remuneraciones + deltas.delta_consumo_intermedio_estimado) / rotation
    : 0;

  const capitalSim =
    capitalBase +
    deltas.delta_stock_capital_imputado +
    capitalCirculatingDelta;

  const rateBase = numberValue(row.tasa_ganancia_pb) * 100;
  const rateSim = capitalSim !== 0 ? gainSim / capitalSim * 100 : NaN;
  const interestsSim = interestsBase + deltas.delta_intereses_industria_pesos;
  const gainPostSim = gainSim - interestsSim;
  const ratePostSim = capitalSim !== 0 ? gainPostSim / capitalSim * 100 : NaN;
  const saldo = gainBase - gainSim;
  const deltaPct = gainBase !== 0 ? (gainSim - gainBase) / gainBase * 100 : NaN;
  const saldoPost = gainPostBase - gainPostSim;

  const components = [
    { label: "VBP", value: -deltas.delta_vbp_pp },
    { label: "Consumo intermedio", value: deltas.delta_consumo_intermedio_estimado },
    { label: "Remuneraciones", value: deltas.delta_remuneraciones },
    { label: "Consumo capital fijo", value: deltas.delta_consumo_capital_fijo },
    { label: "Stock imputado", value: deltas.delta_stock_capital_imputado },
    { label: "Intereses", value: deltas.delta_intereses_industria_pesos }
  ].map(component => ({
    ...component,
    pctGain: gainBase !== 0 ? component.value / gainBase * 100 : NaN
  }));

  return {
    factorBase,
    factorEffective,
    deltas,
    gainBase,
    gainSim,
    gainPostBase,
    gainPostSim,
    capitalBase,
    capitalSim,
    rateBase,
    rateSim,
    ratePostSim,
    saldo,
    saldoPost,
    deltaPct,
    components
  };
}

function mean(values) {
  const finite = values.filter(value => Number.isFinite(value));
  if (finite.length === 0) return NaN;
  return finite.reduce((total, value) => total + value, 0) / finite.length;
}

function rangeLabel(values, formatter) {
  const finite = values.filter(value => Number.isFinite(value));
  if (finite.length === 0) return "s/d";
  const min = Math.min(...finite);
  const max = Math.max(...finite);
  if (Math.abs(max - min) < 1e-9) return formatter(max);
  return `${formatter(min)} a ${formatter(max)}`;
}

function lineChartSvg(data, valueKey, options) {
  const width = 660;
  const height = 360;
  const margin = { top: 20, right: 30, bottom: 86, left: 74 };
  const innerW = width - margin.left - margin.right;
  const innerH = height - margin.top - margin.bottom;
  const years = [...new Set(data.map(row => row.year))].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const sectionValues = SECTIONS.map(section => section.value);
  const values = data.map(row => row[valueKey]).filter(value => Number.isFinite(value));
  let minValue = Math.min(0, ...values);
  let maxValue = Math.max(0, ...values);

  if (Math.abs(maxValue - minValue) < 1e-9) {
    minValue -= 1;
    maxValue += 1;
  }

  const range = maxValue - minValue;
  const xFor = year => {
    if (years.length === 1) return margin.left + innerW / 2;
    return margin.left + (year - years[0]) / (years[years.length - 1] - years[0]) * innerW;
  };
  const yFor = value => margin.top + (maxValue - value) / range * innerH;
  const zeroY = yFor(0);
  const ticks = Array.from({ length: 5 }, (_, i) => minValue + (maxValue - minValue) * i / 4);
  const grid = ticks.map(tick => {
    const y = yFor(tick);
    return `
      <line x1="${margin.left}" x2="${width - margin.right}" y1="${y}" y2="${y}" stroke="${COLORS.grid}" stroke-width="1"></line>
      <text x="${margin.left - 10}" y="${y + 4}" text-anchor="end" fill="${COLORS.grey}" font-size="11">${options.formatTick(tick)}</text>
    `;
  }).join("");
  const xAxis = years.map(year => {
    const x = xFor(year);
    return `
      <line x1="${x}" x2="${x}" y1="${height - margin.bottom}" y2="${height - margin.bottom + 5}" stroke="${COLORS.grey}" stroke-width="1"></line>
      <text x="${x}" y="${height - margin.bottom + 22}" text-anchor="middle" fill="${COLORS.grey}" font-size="12">${year}</text>
    `;
  }).join("");
  const lines = sectionValues.map(sectionValue => {
    const section = SECTIONS.find(item => item.value === sectionValue);
    const sectionRows = data
      .filter(row => row.section === sectionValue && Number.isFinite(row[valueKey]))
      .sort((a, b) => a.year - b.year);
    if (sectionRows.length === 0) return "";
    const path = sectionRows.map((row, index) => {
      const command = index === 0 ? "M" : "L";
      return `${command} ${xFor(row.year).toFixed(2)} ${yFor(row[valueKey]).toFixed(2)}`;
    }).join(" ");
    const points = sectionRows.map(row => `
      <circle cx="${xFor(row.year)}" cy="${yFor(row[valueKey])}" r="3.4" fill="${section.color}"></circle>
    `).join("");
    return `
      <path d="${path}" fill="none" stroke="${section.color}" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"></path>
      ${points}
    `;
  }).join("");
  const legendItemWidth = 170;
  const legendTotalWidth = legendItemWidth * SECTIONS.length;
  const legendStart = margin.left + (innerW - legendTotalWidth) / 2;
  const legend = SECTIONS.map((section, index) => {
    const x = legendStart + index * legendItemWidth;
    const y = height - 24;
    return `
      <line x1="${x}" x2="${x + 26}" y1="${y}" y2="${y}" stroke="${section.color}" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"></line>
      <text x="${x + 34}" y="${y + 4}" fill="${COLORS.navy}" font-size="12">${section.label}</text>
    `;
  }).join("");

  return `
    <svg viewBox="0 0 ${width} ${height}" role="img" width="100%" height="auto">
      ${grid}
      <line x1="${margin.left}" x2="${width - margin.right}" y1="${height - margin.bottom}" y2="${height - margin.bottom}" stroke="${COLORS.grey}" stroke-width="1"></line>
      <line x1="${margin.left}" x2="${margin.left}" y1="${margin.top}" y2="${height - margin.bottom}" stroke="${COLORS.grey}" stroke-width="1"></line>
      <line x1="${margin.left}" x2="${width - margin.right}" y1="${zeroY}" y2="${zeroY}" stroke="${COLORS.navy}" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-dasharray="4 4"></line>
      ${xAxis}
      ${lines}
      ${legend}
    </svg>
  `;
}

function scenarioSeries(rows, state) {
  return rows
    .map(row => {
      const result = computeScenario(row, state);
      const deltaAbs = result.gainSim - result.gainBase;
      return {
        year: Number(row.anno),
        section: row.seccion,
        gainBase: result.gainBase,
        gainSim: result.gainSim,
        deltaAbs,
        deltaAbsBillions: deltaAbs / 1e9,
        deltaPct: result.deltaPct,
        factorEffectivePct: result.factorEffective * 100
      };
    })
    .sort((a, b) => a.year - b.year || a.section.localeCompare(b.section));
}

function summaryTable(series) {
  const tag = name => `<${name}>`;
  const endTag = name => `</${name}>`;
  const cell = (content, name = "td") => `${tag(name)}${content}${endTag(name)}`;
  const years = [...new Set(series.map(row => row.year))].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const body = years.map(year => {
    const cells = SECTIONS.map(section => {
      const row = series.find(item => item.year === year && item.section === section.value);
      if (!row) return cell("s/d");
      return cell(`${moneyBillions(row.deltaAbs)}<br><span>${percent(row.deltaPct)}</span>`);
    }).join("");
    return `${tag("tr")}${cell(year)}${cells}${endTag("tr")}`;
  }).join("");

  return [
    tag("table"),
    tag("thead"),
    tag("tr"),
    cell("Año", "th"),
    SECTIONS.map(section => cell(section.label, "th")).join(""),
    endTag("tr"),
    endTag("thead"),
    `${tag("tbody")}${body}${endTag("tbody")}`,
    endTag("table"),
    "<p class=\"source-note\">Cada celda reporta cambio absoluto de ganancia en miles de millones de pesos corrientes y, debajo, cambio porcentual respecto de la ganancia inicial.</p>"
  ].join("");
}

function renderModule(module, data) {
  const scenario = module.dataset.scenario;
  const rows = data.filter(row => row.escenario === scenario && SECTIONS.some(section => section.value === row.seccion));
  const years = [...new Set(rows.map(row => Number(row.anno)))].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const container = module.querySelector(".sim-content");
  const state = {
    devaluation: 0,
    intensities: Object.fromEntries(VARIABLES.map(variable => [variable.key, 100]))
  };

  container.innerHTML = `
    <div class="sim-layout">
      <div class="sim-controls">
        <div class="control-panel">
          <h4>Magnitud de la devaluación</h4>
          <div class="control-row">
            <label>Cierre de brecha TCC-TCP</label>
            <input type="range" min="0" max="150" step="1" value="0" data-control="devaluation">
            <div class="control-value" data-value="devaluation">0%</div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="control-panel">
          <h4>Incidencias por componente</h4>
          ${VARIABLES.map(variable => `
            <div class="control-row">
              <label>${variable.label}</label>
              <input type="range" min="0" max="100" step="1" value="100" data-control="${variable.key}">
              <div class="control-value" data-value="${variable.key}">100%</div>
            </div>
          `).join("")}
        </div>
        <div class="control-panel control-panel-action">
          <button class="reset-button" type="button">Volver al escenario inicial</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div>
        <div class="metrics-grid" data-role="metrics"></div>
        <div class="chart-row">
          <div class="chart-box">
            <h4>Delta absoluto de ganancia</h4>
            <div data-role="delta-abs-chart"></div>
          </div>
          <div class="chart-box">
            <h4>Delta relativo sobre ganancia inicial</h4>
            <div data-role="delta-pct-chart"></div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="sim-table" data-role="summary-table"></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  `;

  function update() {
    const series = scenarioSeries(rows, state);
    if (series.length === 0) {
      container.querySelector('[data-role="metrics"]').innerHTML = "<p>No hay datos disponibles para la selección.</p>";
      return;
    }

    container.querySelector('[data-value="devaluation"]').textContent = `${state.devaluation}%`;
    VARIABLES.forEach(variable => {
      container.querySelector(`[data-value="${variable.key}"]`).textContent = `${state.intensities[variable.key]}%`;
    });

    container.querySelector('[data-role="metrics"]').innerHTML = `
      <div class="metric-card"><span>Período</span><strong>${years[0]}-${years[years.length - 1]}</strong></div>
      <div class="metric-card"><span>Series visibles</span><strong>${SECTIONS.length}</strong></div>
      <div class="metric-card"><span>Factor efectivo promedio</span><strong>${percent(mean(series.map(row => row.factorEffectivePct)))}</strong></div>
      <div class="metric-card"><span>Delta absoluto</span><strong>${rangeLabel(series.map(row => row.deltaAbs), moneyBillions)}</strong></div>
    `;

    container.querySelector('[data-role="delta-abs-chart"]').innerHTML = lineChartSvg(series, "deltaAbsBillions", {
      formatTick: value => value.toLocaleString("es-UY", { maximumFractionDigits: 1, minimumFractionDigits: 1 })
    });
    container.querySelector('[data-role="delta-pct-chart"]').innerHTML = lineChartSvg(series, "deltaPct", {
      formatTick: value => `${value.toLocaleString("es-UY", { maximumFractionDigits: 0, minimumFractionDigits: 0 })}%`
    });
    container.querySelector('[data-role="summary-table"]').innerHTML = summaryTable(series);
  }

  container.addEventListener("input", event => {
    const control = event.target.dataset.control;
    if (!control) return;
    if (control === "devaluation") state.devaluation = Number(event.target.value);
    if (VARIABLES.some(variable => variable.key === control)) state.intensities[control] = Number(event.target.value);
    update();
  });

  container.addEventListener("click", event => {
    if (!event.target.classList.contains("reset-button")) return;
    state.devaluation = 0;
    VARIABLES.forEach(variable => state.intensities[variable.key] = 100);
    container.querySelector('[data-control="devaluation"]').value = 0;
    VARIABLES.forEach(variable => {
      container.querySelector(`[data-control="${variable.key}"]`).value = 100;
    });
    update();
  });

  update();
}

fetch(DATA_URL)
  .then(response => {
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`No se pudo cargar ${DATA_URL}`);
    return response.json();
  })
  .then(data => {
    document.querySelectorAll(".scenario-simulator").forEach(module => renderModule(module, data));
  })
  .catch(error => {
    document.querySelectorAll(".sim-content").forEach(container => {
      container.innerHTML = `<p>No se pudo cargar el módulo interactivo: ${error.message}</p>`;
    });
  });
</script>

## Nota técnica

La simulación aplica:

```text
factor_efectivo = intensidad_devaluacion * (tipo_cambio_paridad / tipo_cambio_comercial - 1)
```

Cada variable afectada usa su coeficiente de incidencia y el porcentaje elegido
en el slider correspondiente. El stock imputado incide en el capital total
adelantado; los intereses inciden en la ganancia post intereses.
